title: Remove or independently enable the unreachable inline-delegation boot timing phase
outcome: The inline-delegation timing phase either has a reachable enabled execution path or is removed, with accurate fixed-label boot measurements.
acceptance: The delegations_inline phase is removed, or timing enablement is independent of defer_delegations and the enabled inline path is covered by a behavioral test.
Boot restore behavior and deferred-delegation loading remain unchanged; relevant focused validation passes.
